summary: NIFTY at LTP and at Quote, its streaming id (-23) known from an earlier index quote: an index quote frame, then a partial one with a new price and change.

notes: Indices subscribe by Samco's listingId with no segment suffix (samcoWebSocket.py subscribe). The case's feed knows NIFTY's id as the desktop learns it from a REST index quote (brokers/samco/data.rs index_details); the web glue answers _get_index_listing_id with the same id.

deviations.reason: For an index the web sends a best bid and ask of 0 that Samco never sent (an index has no book; the frame has no bPr/aPr); the desktop leaves them out.

As last_quantity: its Samco alias goes with it.
data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.
The desktop sends an index's change under its canonical name price_change, as the recorded Zerodha index transcript does, beside Samco's web name change with the same value.
As price_change, beside Samco's web name change_percentage.
